recommended_action: Redesign the B-PARENT-CONFOUND negative control so its signal is robust to 304 inclusion/exclusion. Two approaches: (1) Use a different confound mechanism that does not rely on 304 structural composition (e.g., make expired responses use a fixed non-UUID request_id pattern that does not depend on 304 vs non-304 path, or introduce a body-level confound that affects non-304 responses equally); (2) Define C7 strictly on the non-304 subset and ensure the confound reproduces without 304s (currently data_list shows r=-0.247 on non-304, profile shows r=0.058, session shows r=-0.042 — pooled -0.074 is too weak; strengthen the confound on profile/session or narrow C7 to data_list only). The V_ETAG fix, C5 stratification, and V3 pooling are all verified correct — only the negative control mechanism needs redesign. If C7 can be made to PASS under consistent non-304 exclusion, the experiment yields CONFIRMED (all C1-C7 pass) and C-FRESHNESS advances toward VALIDATED. Consider increasing n_non304 to >=800 for tighter CI at delta=0.10.
